$comment: 주차장명 (requirement 4). NO `insights` — deliberately, and it is not a missing field: the schema does permit insights on a string, but this value is the name of a parking lot. It changes only when a building office renames the lot, so logging it would produce an empty graph and nothing else. `setable: false` + `uiComponent: sensor` is the only legal shape for a string here — Homey has no free-text tile input, which is also why the settings page is this app's primary UI. See iparking_lib/const.py's CAPABILITY_PARK_NAME. (Homey ignores unknown keys; `homey app validate --level publish` passes with this one present.)
